1. (Currently Amended) A cleanable, waterborne polyurethane dispersion comprising the reaction product of: A) one or more OH-functional acrylic dispersions and B) one or more __zwitterionic buffer-modified__ polyisocyanates, __wherein the zwitterionic buffer is selected from the group consisting of 3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid (CAPS) and 2-(cyclohexylamino)-ethanesulfonic acid (CHES)__.

2. (Currently Amended) The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component A) comprises at least two __different__ OH-functional acrylic dispersions.

3. (Currently Amended) The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component B) comprises at least one __zwitterionic buffer-modified__ polyisocyanate __derived from__ an aliphatic diisocyanate.

4. (Original) The dispersion of claim 3, wherein the aliphatic diisocyanate is 1,6-diisocyanatohexane.

5. (Original) A method of producing a cleanable coating on a substrate comprising applying the dispersion of claim 1 to the substrate and curing the coating composition.

6. (Original) A coating produced according to the method of claim 5.

7. (Original) The coating of claim 6, wherein the surface energy of the coating is greater than 31.0 dynes/cm.

8. (Currently Amended) The coating of claim 7, wherein the __root mean square__ surface roughness of the coating is greater than 200 nm.
